title: Location Disclosure
description: The child's device transmits live GPS coordinates, which could be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to potential tracking of the child's location.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The live GPS coordinates transmitted from the child's device to the backend could be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive location data.

title: Data Retention and Misuse
description: The backend may store the GPS coordinates for longer than necessary or use them for purposes other than intended, leading to privacy violations.

title: Data Disclosure from Location Pings
description: The backend process writes location pings to the Location History Store, which may lead to the unintended disclosure of personal location data if not properly secured or if access controls are inadequate.

title: Data Disclosure in Location History Store
description: The Location History Store may expose personal location data to unauthorized access or sharing, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Data Disclosure through Location Sharing
description: The mobile app backend (P1) forwards location pings to the Geofencing & Alert Engine (P2), which may lead to the unintended disclosure of users' location data to unauthorized parties if proper access controls are not in place.

title: Inadequate User Consent for Data Processing
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine (P2) processes location data, which may occur without adequate user consent or transparency regarding how the data will be used, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Unauthorized Access to Family Account
description: There is a risk that unauthorized users may gain access to the Family Account Store, leading to potential misuse of sensitive information such as zone definitions.

title: Inadequate Data Handling Practices
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may not handle the retrieved zone definitions securely, leading to potential exposure of sensitive location data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may retain the zone definitions longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Management
description: The Geofencing Engine may not have obtained proper consent from the child or parent before sending arrival/departure notifications, leading to potential legal and ethical issues regarding privacy.

title: Insecure Data Handling by Parent
description: The parent entity may not handle the received notifications securely, leading to unauthorized access or misuse of sensitive location data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The parent may retain the arrival/departure notifications longer than necessary, violating data minimization principles and increasing the risk of data breaches.

title: Inadequate Consent Mechanism
description: The parent may not fully understand what data is being collected or how it will be used when registering an account and creating the child's profile, leading to a lack of informed consent.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's profile data (name, DOB, school) for purposes other than intended, such as marketing or sharing with third parties without consent.

title: Data Interception
description: Data in transit between the parent and the mobile app backend could be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to potential identity theft or unauthorized access to the child's profile.

title: Data Disclosure from Mobile App Backend
description: The Mobile App Backend (Process) may unintentionally disclose personal data (account, child profile, geofence zone data) to unauthorized parties during the storage process or through improper access controls.

title: Data Disclosure at Family Account & Permissions Store
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store (DataStore) may expose personal data to unauthorized access or sharing, leading to potential data breaches or misuse of sensitive information.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent may not have provided explicit consent for the mobile app to access the child's location data, leading to a potential violation of privacy rights.

title: Insecure Data Storage
description: The mobile app backend may store the child's location data insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's location data for purposes other than what was originally intended or disclosed to the parent.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The location history stored in the DataStore may be accessed by unauthorized processes or users, leading to potential leakage of sensitive location data.

title: Inadequate Access Control
description: The Mobile App Backend may not have adequate access controls in place, allowing unauthorized access to the retrieved location history data.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Mobile App Backend may misuse the retrieved location history data for purposes other than intended, such as selling or sharing with third parties without consent.

title: Linkability Threat
description: The parent sharing the child's location with a secondary guardian may lead to linkability threats if the secondary guardian's identity can be linked to the child's location data, potentially exposing the child's whereabouts to unauthorized parties.

title: Informed Consent Threat
description: The mobile app backend may process the child's location data without ensuring that the secondary guardian is fully informed about the implications of accessing this data, leading to potential privacy violations.

title: Data Retention Threat
description: The mobile app backend may retain the child's location data longer than necessary for the purpose of sharing it with the secondary guardian, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The backend process may inadvertently grant access to the secondary guardian without proper authentication or authorization checks, leading to unauthorized access to the child's live location data.

title: Insecure Handling of Location Data
description: The secondary guardian may mishandle the received live location data, such as sharing it with unauthorized parties or storing it insecurely, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Loss of Control over Personal Data
description: The mobile app backend shares aggregated usage and engagement analytics with an external advertising/analytics partner, which may lead to loss of control over how this data is used or further shared by the partner.

title: Inadequate Information Handling by External Entity
description: The advertising/analytics partner may inadequately handle the aggregated analytics data, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Data Misuse by External Entity
description: The external advertising/analytics partner may misuse the aggregated data for purposes not aligned with the original intent of sharing, such as targeted advertising without user consent.

title: Attributable data evidence
description: The SOS message sent by the child can be attributed to the child, potentially exposing their identity and location to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure data processing
description: The mobile app backend may process the child's location data insecurely, leading to potential exposure or misuse of sensitive information.

title: Linkability of data
description: The location data sent by the child can be linked to their identity, which may allow unauthorized users to track the child's movements.
